_doc: ABLATION ROUND (2026-11-13; the user: 'go over these things one by one, ablate them on every map, see which thing actually does the job, and then ... merge it into our recipe ... first solve the map ... with our recipe plus [the] things ... which were in the recipe that actually beat the map'). Wave 1 = ALL-IN: the fix round's try-1 recipe (89 tokens) plus every training piece October's unitfarmer2 lineage had at its pit exit and the try-3 yaw cap, as named groups: death, novelty, energy, greedy, front, keytemp, yaw, tick. ONE list for every map; only --maxvel follows the map's server physics. From scratch, one seed. Owner abpb. BEFORE: FIX ROUND, TRY 3 (2026-11-12): the try-1 recipe plus ONE generic piece, --yaw-sigma-max 0.5 (a ceiling on the yaw head's state-independent sigma under the absolute view: the pitch head's existing cap, the same constant 0.5; flag ported from 04524bae). Try 2's --yaw-entropy 0 is removed: with the bonus off the sigma still reached its 2.718 clamp (ledger fx/sib 80fe14f9). The cap never binds on the six other maps (max yaw sigma 0.30-0.39 over every run). From scratch, one seed, run <owner>_t3. BEFORE: FIX ROUND, TRY 2 (2026-11-12): the try-1 recipe plus ONE generic learning piece, --yaw-entropy 0 (the yaw head takes no share of the entropy bonus, as the pitch head already does under the absolute view; flag of 2026-10-23, commit c416c4a8). Why: on princessburglar the state-independent yaw sigma sat at its 2.718 clamp from 100M steps for 2B+ in the try-1 run and in the frozen run, on no other map, and the handed pit line was not learned (ledger fx/sib 9ab21526). From scratch, one seed, run <owner>_t2. BEFORE: FIX ROUND, TRY 1 (2026-11-12, branch fx/sib; the user: 'Okay, I think you can implement steps 1 and 2 for the beginning'): the frozen sidistic recipe with ONE changed piece, the same on every map: a field-free Go-Explore stage in the search loop (5 minutes per archive kind, held and contact; plain cell key) and four bookkeeping flags (--auto-spine-current-ref, --auto-spine-patience-tau, --auto-spine-finish-stop, --demo-match-band). From scratch, one seed. Only --maxvel follows the map's server physics, as before. Agent / box owner fxpb. BEFORE THIS ROUND: The second-map test (2026-11-10), the harness's seventh program: the recipes that finished surf_src_sidistic from scratch in the one-search series (~/ar_az) run UNCHANGED on surf_princessburglar_b26. CLAUDE.md 0b: a winner is called only when the SAME recipe repeats on a second map with no constant changed. Operator-run, no agents and no orchestrator: a frozen recipe leaves nothing to design. Two arms, one seed each, from scratch at the true start: m2sib (branch m2/sib = azr1b2_pool's commit 4644510b: one pool of spawns + the sibling-yield mix rule in the tree search; sidistic first finish 7.248B steps) and m2pool (branch m2/pool = azr1b1_pool1's commit da7981e5: one pool, the search at the random end; sidistic first finish 14.194B). Every number here is a HARD limit that box.py and the watchdog enforce.
goal: Does the recipe that finishes sidistic also finish princessburglar from the true start, champion-free, with no flag or constant changed? Read by finishes inside the real finish trigger and the step of the first one; without a finish, by the best progress on the grader's field and where the greedy policy stops. The human record (75.18 s) is a bar to read results against, never a constant.
_field_doc: The princessburglar program's grader field (~/RL_Surf_pb): the goal graph WITHOUT corner cutting at lidar cell 32, the field the recipe shapes on (--race-no-corner-cut 1): 507,547 reachable voxels, start d 57,149 u. Baked 2026-10-23; the files are that program's (~/ar_pb/maps/pb_maps.tar.gz, md5 a3713838), copied with their mtimes.
_score_episodes_doc: score.py counts only the first N episodes of an eval (header episode index < N): its score is a max over episodes, so an eval with more episodes would buy lottery tickets (r6b1 scored 98.418 with 54-episode evals of the incumbent's weights). 0 = all.
_rounds_doc: The user, 2026-11-10 11:31 UTC, on the one-search series: 'I think we can call it. Let's wrap it up, and then start the methods that did converge on other map. E.g. princessburglar'. No orchestrator runs here; round_hours / rounds are unused.
_max_boxes_doc: One box per arm (box.py allows one per 'agent' name: m2sib, m2pool (released 2026-11-10 16:40 UTC), m2warm = the transfer arm, m2ge = the diagnostic search-swap arm of 2026-11-10 18:20 UTC on the user's instruction, which raised the cap 2 -> 3). The droplet's ONE fleet watchdog daemon enforces its own cap; boxes are registered in its registry (RLSURF_FLEET_DIR=~/ar/fleet).
_budget_end_hours_doc: Hours from this program's start (state.json started) over which box.py spreads the credit above the reserve: ~$11.5 above the $10 reserve at the start = two fast boxes for about 14 h. No top-ups by the operator.
_max_dph_doc: $/h for the WHOLE box, its disk_gb of storage included: box.py prices offers with --storage disk_gb, and the fleet watchdog checks the instance's dph_total against its own caps (this table is a subset of them). FAST cards first in this program, because a 26 h round is read in steps: measured on the recipe last round, RTX 5080 368k steps/s, RTX 4080 282k, RTX 3090 215k, RTX 5060 Ti 125-179k (the host CPU is half of it). So tier 0 is the 5080 class, then the 3090s, then two 16 GB fallbacks, then a 4090 or 5090 at its old cap; the 4070 / 3080 / 5060 class of 2026-10-25 is out (10B steps in 20 h would not reach the late walls). Caps sit just above the market of 2026-11-09 (5080 0.28-0.31, 4080S 0.41, 3090 0.29-0.36): a 5080 at 0.59 is double the going rate and is not rented (CLAUDE.md: never rent above the market price).
offer_query: num_gpus=1 cuda_vers>=12.8 reliability>0.98 inet_down>300 rentable=true disk_space>60 cpu_cores_effective>=32 cpu_ghz>=2.5 verified=true gpu_ram>=12
_cpu_exclude_doc: Regexes on the offer's cpu_name. vast's cpu_ghz is the TURBO clock (a Haswell E5-2696 v3 lists 3.8 GHz), so it does not catch old server parts: box 56818837, a 3090 on dual Xeon E5-2699 v3 (72 threads, Haswell 2014), trained the incumbent recipe at 57-59k steps/s with the trainer at 5,400% CPU and the GPU 5% busy, against 166-269k on 32-thread Zen 3 / Zen 4 / Raptor Lake hosts (2026-10-20).
_harness_files_doc: The operator's files: at the start of every round orchestrator.py restores them from the main checkout's HEAD over the winner's head, so a branch cannot carry its own caps, grader or rules forward, and the operator's fixes reach every round. autoresearch/NOTES.md is NOT one of them: it is the lineage's memory and travels with the winner. tools/bad_hosts.json is merged instead (the union of every branch's list).
_lineage_keys_doc: Keys of this file that belong to the lineage, not the operator: when the winner changed one during its round, its value travels into the next round's config.json (r1b1 made its scratch recipe the incumbent_recipe on 2026-10-20). Everything else here is restored from the operator's HEAD.
_offer_query_doc: Scratch training here is CPU-bound: the trainer takes half the container's CPUs for physics. A 16-thread 3090 box ran the incumbent recipe at ~36k steps/s (2026-10-20, smoke_x1) against ~420k on the 5090 PC, so boxes need >= 32 effective threads on a fast CPU. Measured the same night on a 3090 + Ryzen 9 5950X box (32 threads, quota 30.7 CPUs, omp 15): ~194k steps/s, GPU 30% busy. gpu_ram>=12 (GB; 2026-10-25): the cheaper cards' 8 GB variants are out, every good card has 16-24 GB.
_incumbent_recipe_doc: ABLATION ROUND recipe: the 89 try-1 tokens + groups {"death": ["--death-charge", "1", "--death-charge-window", "2"], "novelty": ["--int-coef", "2.5", "--int-view", "0", "--int-speed", "8", "--int-speed-weight", "3", "--int-speed-weight-up"], "energy": ["--energy-pot", "12"], "greedy": ["--respawn-greedy", "0.25", "--respawn-greedy-stuck", "200", "--respawn-greedy-window", "0.25", "2.0", "--respawn-greedy-speed", "1.0", "1.3", "--respawn-greedy-turn", "180", "--respawn-greedy-temp", "1.0", "--respawn-greedy-temp-ticks", "100"], "front": ["--respawn-front-perturb", "0.25", "--respawn-front-perturb-band", "0.005", "--respawn-front-perturb-speed", "1.0", "1.3", "--respawn-front-perturb-turn", "90"], "keytemp": ["--unstuck-max", "0.5", "--unstuck-patience", "2e7", "--unstuck-period", "2e7", "--unstuck-reach", "res"], "yaw": ["--yaw-entropy", "0", "--yaw-sigma-max", "0.5"], "tick": ["--tick-ms", "7.63"]} (energy replaces --energy-pot 3; keytemp replaces --unstuck-max 0.2 and --unstuck-reach eval). Launch extra unchanged: -- --auto-spine-mcts-args '--mcts-mix-rule sib --mcts-mix-floor 0.05 --mcts-mix-horizon 256 --mcts-mix-warm 2'. BEFORE: TRY 3 of the fix round: the 89 try-1 tokens plus --yaw-sigma-max 0.5 (91 tokens); the launch extra is unchanged. BEFORE: TRY 2 of the fix round: the 89 try-1 tokens plus --yaw-entropy 0 (91 tokens); the launch extra is unchanged. BEFORE: TRY 1 of the fix round: the 83 frozen tokens with --auto-spine-ge-minutes 5 (was 0) plus --auto-spine-args '--ge-cell-heading 0 --ge-view-follow none --ge-boost 1.0 --ge-held 1 --ge-cell-contact 1' --auto-spine-current-ref --auto-spine-patience-tau --auto-spine-finish-stop --demo-match-band. The launch adds, as every frozen run did: -- --auto-spine-mcts-args '--mcts-mix-rule sib --mcts-mix-floor 0.05 --mcts-mix-horizon 256 --mcts-mix-warm 2'. BEFORE: The flag list BOTH finishing sidistic runs were launched with (box.log 2026-11-09 20:47:43 azr1b1_pool1 and 2026-11-10 01:58:26 azr1b2_pool, identical up to the last argument), minus that last argument, which each arm passes itself: --auto-spine-mcts-args '--mcts-mix-rule sib --mcts-mix-floor 0.05 --mcts-mix-horizon 256 --mcts-mix-warm 2' (m2sib) or '--mcts-random-frac 1.0 --mcts-perturb-frac 0' (m2pool). ONE token differs from sidistic: --maxvel 3500 instead of 4000. That is the map's server physics (sv_maxvelocity; every princessburglar, unitfarmer2 and za_loop run of the earlier programs used 3500, sidistic 4000), part of the environment like the .bsp, not a constant of the method. Launch: box.py launch --agent m2sib --run m2sib_pb1 --steps 60e9 -- --auto-spine-mcts-args '<the arm's string>'.
_agent_prefix_doc: Ablation round: box owners ab<map>, run names <owner>_<arm>.
_budget_doc: No budget_rate_usd_h: box.py's pacer. The reserve is held by extend's burn x hours check and by the box deadlines.
_time_cap_s_doc: score.py's time term is 10 * (1 - best_finish_s / time_cap_s): 300 s, the episode cap.
